mapper.sql: SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, DR.TARGET_ID AS targetId, DR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, COALESCE(H.NAME, S.NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS hospitalName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.REG_DATE AS reviewRegDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT RR WHERE RR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID) AS reportCount FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST DR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = DR.REVIEW_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = DR.TARGET_ID AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = DR.BIZ_NO

if.test: statusCd != null and statusCd != '' and statusCd != 'ALL'

where.if: AND ( H.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR S.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR B.BIZ_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DR.REQUEST_REASON LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED', ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.sql: SELECT RR.REPORT_ID AS reportId, RR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, RR.BIZ_NO AS bizNo, RR.REASON AS reason, RR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, RR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, RR.REG_DATE AS regDate, RR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, RM.NICKNAME AS reporterNickname, R.REVIEW_TYPE AS reviewType, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent, WM.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, COALESCE(P.PRODUCT_NAME, H.NAME, S.NAME) AS targetName, B.BIZ_NAME AS bizName FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT RR LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER RM ON RM.MEMBER_NO = RR.REPORTER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = RR.REVIEW_ID LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER WM ON WM.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.TARGET_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' LEFT JOIN TB_HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = R.TARGET_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = R.TARGET_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' LEFT JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON B.BIZ_NO = RR.BIZ_NO

if.test: statusCd != null and statusCd != '' and statusCd != 'ALL'

where.if: AND ( P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR H.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR S.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR B.BIZ_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR RM.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR WM.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR RR.REASON LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW_REPORT WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW_REPORT SET STATUS_CD = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADMIN_NO = #{adminNo}, PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO FROM TB_BUSINESS B JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = B.BIZ_ID OR M.EMAIL = B.BIZ_ID WHERE B.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
